question: What understanding has been gained through the grace of the lord of Kaulas?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of Kaulas
Knowledge arose by that lord's grace
The knowledge concerns the determination of Kaula
inference: By your grace, O lord of Kaulas, I have come to know the determination of Kaula.
plain_english: By your grace, O lord of the Kaulas, I have come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
